verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent controls, mostly scoped to Sprites (agent sandboxes) rather than app environments. Sprites can get egress policies and be egress-locked, and access to connected services can be granted by Sprite name, label, or single endpoint, which could keep a non-prod workload away from a production service. Nothing addresses separating staging and production Fly Apps or networks. Missing for 10: documented separation of production and non-production apps or networks (e.g. separate private networks or orgs, or network policies between apps), environment-level firewall/egress rules for Fly Machines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
